name: Gappy's Adventure - Coinkeeper's Cantrip
detailed_description:
Gappy's Adventure was not only created to be a fun platforming game, but to make a beautiful piece of interactive art. Designed from the ground-up to feel truly special <3

  • FRESH MOVEMENT! / Making Gappy feel as fun to control as possible was TOP PRIORITY! taking inspiration from both 2D and 3D platformers from all generations, Gappy is equipped with multiple different moves that can be chained together, giving YOU the freedom to tackle levels however you like! Play as casually or complex as you like! 

  • MORE THAN JUST LEVELS! / Each level was lovingly designed to be MORE than just a shallow obstacle course. Although ALL Levels are packed to the brim with fun & challenging platforming, the game gives you time to simply soak in the lovely scenery, or completely mix up how you play! You'll never know what's coming next! 

  • FUN FOR ALL! / Gappy was designed for all skill levels in mind! Without sacrificing it's spine. No invincibility or level skips after too many failed attempts here! Simply put, levels don't REQUIRE that you maintain top speed, pull-off complex maneuvers or chain together crazy combos, just highly rewards them! Speaking of which . . . 

  • PERFECTED PLAY! / Every level records your BEST TIME and BEST SCORE! Break every block, collect every tab, and max-out combos to set crazy Highscores! And do it all quickly to try and set a best time too! Share records with your friends, or see just how far you can push yourself! 

  • EXTRA STUFF! / Unlockable Post-Game Levels, Built-in Custom level Creator, Debug Mode, Rare Collectible Cards and MUCH MUCH MORE!

short_description: Gappy's Adventure - Coinkeeper's Cantrip is the 2D platformer you've been dreaming of. Spectacular movement, charming visuals, and surprises around every corner! Take control of the lovely, green 'Gappy' as he stops the diabolical plans of the evil 'Coinkeeper'
reviews:
“Fans of Meat Boy will love this this retro action-platformer with a heavy emphasis on control and movement”
Tom Fulp

  • Processor: 11th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Storage: 12 MB available space
